Scratchpad mutation records EV-MUT-{L2,L3,H2,L1,L4,L5} replaced by reproducible mutation evidence EV-KB-* (security/mutation/cases.json, 66 cases). EV-CRSF-SELFTEST and EV-PROBE-LOW-S added. Owner sign-off field added (PENDING). Framework lock bootstrapped. No control definition, release class or minimum level changed.

versions.summary: Evidence closure for release-blocking controls: 11 closed (CR-API-002, CR-TELEGRAM-001, CR-AUTH-001/002/003/007, CR-SESSION-002/003/005/007, CR-CONC-005); 6 new test files, 37 new mutation cases; the Phase 2A surviving cron mutation is now KILLED. No application code changed.

changes.why_sufficient: P1 cron: missing/wrong/same-length/malformed secrets rejected before any run, purge, delivery or alert; removing the check or comparing by length is killed. P2 webhook: Phase 2A case. P3: unconfigured CRON_SECRET and webhook secret fail closed; removing either guard is killed (E4 for every sub-property).
changes.remains_unproven: Vercel Cron and Telegram delivering the headers in production; constant-time comparison is not behaviourally observable.
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2B)

changes.why_sufficient: P1 secret bypass and length-only compare killed; P2 removing the private-chat guard killed by the existing "webhook ignores ..." tests (no database call); P3 redelivered update_id processed once, killed both when the claim is skipped and when 23505 is treated as new.
changes.remains_unproven: Primary-key uniqueness under truly concurrent deliveries (the fake models the primary key; Postgres enforces it).
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2B)

changes.why_sufficient: P1-P3 from Phase 2A cases; P4 issued-at and expiration-time must equal the stored challenge (two mutations SURVIVED until the new test - a real evidence gap, now closed), future issued-at and expired challenge killed; P5 address comparison removal killed.
changes.remains_unproven: Interop with real wallets; viem parseSiweMessage correctness itself.
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2B)

changes.why_sufficient: P1 Phase 2A; P2 consuming the challenge or issuing a session after a failed signature is killed by the existing login and H1 tests.
changes.remains_unproven: Signatures from real hardware wallets.
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2B)

changes.why_sufficient: P3 unpinned isValidSignature and ignored block-hash disagreement killed; P4 provider error as VALID, deadline as VALID and ignored getCode disagreement killed.
changes.remains_unproven: Behaviour against real mainnet providers and real Safe contracts.
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2B)

changes.why_sufficient: P2 expired EOA (7 d) and contract (24 h) sessions and P3 expired action confirmations refused; exempting either type from exp is killed. P1/P4 from Phase 2A.
changes.remains_unproven: Clock skew between instances.
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2B)

changes.why_sufficient: Challenge/session/action substitution and purpose swapping refused; accepting a challenge as session, any token as action, or ignoring the purpose is killed.
changes.remains_unproven: None beyond the HMAC boundary itself (CR-SESSION-001 P2/P3 stay open).
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2B)

changes.why_sufficient: P1 a session token in the login body is caught by the existing M1/Safe-App tests; P2 a Bearer fallback in the single session resolver is killed.
changes.remains_unproven: Real browser JavaScript access (HttpOnly is asserted on the Set-Cookie header, not observed in a browser).
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2B)

changes.why_sufficient: P1 contract sessions without fresh authority killed; P2 legacy tokens without fresh authority and a getCode outage treated as "no code" killed; P3 not consuming the fresh confirmation killed by the replay assertion (409).
changes.remains_unproven: MUT-CR-AUTH-007-P2-NEW1 was dropped as an equivalent mutant: its catch branch is unreachable because perProvider() turns every provider error into {ok:false}; documented, not counted.
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2B)

changes.why_sufficient: Real Postgres: logout via the real handler writes the cutoff; every earlier session is refused at all five authenticated endpoint/method combinations; a later session works; the test kills a skipped server-side revoke, each endpoint ignoring revocation and an off-by-one boundary. Replaces the source-text-only evidence.
changes.remains_unproven: Production PostgREST/Supabase; attribution POST/DELETE share the GET session check and were not called separately.
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2B)

changes.why_sufficient: 2/10/25 truly concurrent revokes (barrier, zero timeouts) always store the maximum; a later lower request never lowers it; removing the max-merge or the advisory lock is killed.
changes.remains_unproven: Production database load.
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2B)
Phase 2A recorded SURVIVED (no test called /api/alerts without CRON_SECRET). test/cron-auth.test.mjs now kills it for the intended reason; declared KILLED.
catch { return false } in freshAuthorityRequired is unreachable: noContractCodeByQuorum never throws on provider failure. Replaced by MUT-CR-AUTH-007-P2-NEW3 on the reachable outage path.

P2 (stored expiry at the on-chain call site) is enforced twice (open check + atomic consume); removing one layer is equivalent at the security level and survives, so no single-property call-site mutation can prove it at E4. Not closed; the H2 primitive proof was not borrowed for a call-site property.
P2 constant-time comparison and P3 algorithm/key not selectable are not behaviourally observable with the current harness; left MISSING_EVIDENCE.
P1/P3 mutations that keep the signature check are equivalent (the session wallet is always the verified wallet); no honest E4 proof built in this batch.
allowed skip added for test/session-revocation-db.test.mjs :: REVOKE-DB, only while M1_DB_TEST_PG_URL is unset (same rule as M1/H2/L1/L5).
No control definition, release class, minimum level or profile threshold changed; lock regenerated for 1.0-draft-phase2b only.

versions.summary: Evidence closure continued: 10 release-blocking controls closed (CR-DB-001/002, CR-AUTH-004/006/008, CR-API-001, CR-VERIFY-001/002/005/009); EQUIVALENT and MULTI_LAYER mutation semantics; two framework fixes; one test-infrastructure finding; two framework-policy gaps reported. No application code changed.

changes.why_sufficient: Real Postgres with Supabase default grants emulated before all migrations: RLS on every table; anon/authenticated hold no table privilege and are refused (42501) on real read/insert/delete; no role can CREATE in public. Disabling RLS, granting SELECT/INSERT or CREATE are each caught. Replaces the manual-only production check as reproducible evidence.
changes.remains_unproven: The production database itself (supabase_admin-owned objects, real Supabase defaults); EV-PROD-DB remains the manual production record.
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2C)

changes.why_sufficient: Every public function: no anon/authenticated/PUBLIC execute (catalog and real call -> 42501); service_role reaches exactly the 5 runtime RPCs plus the documented legacy consume_wallet_link; internal helpers are callable by nobody. Granting a runtime RPC to authenticated, leaving a helper to service_role, or leaving PUBLIC execute are each caught.
changes.remains_unproven: consume_wallet_link (legacy, service_role only) still exists - known hardening item, not a violation of P1.
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2C)

changes.why_sufficient: Construction proof, not statistics: with node:crypto.randomBytes intercepted, every challenge/action nonce, request id, link code/nonce and access code equals the full encoding of one randomBytes draw of >= 16 bytes (128/144/192 bits); Math.random throws if used. Math.random, clock-derived, shortened, truncated or padded values are each caught.
changes.remains_unproven: The OS CSPRNG behind node:crypto (platform assumption).
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2C)

changes.why_sufficient: P1/P2: the real dashboard and positions handlers read only the session wallet; header, query, body, foreign-cookie and Bearer hints for another wallet never reach a lookup or the response; taking the wallet from a header or body is killed. P3/P4 from Phase 2A.
changes.remains_unproven: Endpoints added later must be added to the scope test.
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2C)

changes.why_sufficient: End-to-end with the real challenge SQL: expired stored rows, replays (sequential and 10 concurrent) and an attacker Safe approving the victim text never yield a session. Each defect is a MULTI_LAYER mutation that removes every redundant layer (handler check, approval verifier, SQL predicates) and is killed; the single-layer removal is recorded as EQUIVALENT with proof instead of as a gap.
changes.remains_unproven: Real Safe contracts on mainnet (simulated chain).
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2C)

changes.why_sufficient: P1: decoupling the session wallet from the signer (claimed-wallet check + consume/issue for the challenge wallet) lets an attacker key turn a victim challenge into a victim session - killed. P2: ignoring or forcing contract authority killed by existing session-kind tests. P3: pinning the issue time (re-login reuses the old token, which stays revoked) killed by a real logout-then-login.
changes.remains_unproven: Phase 2B called P1/P3 untestable; the gap was the missing end-to-end attack test, not the threshold.
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2C)

changes.why_sufficient: The real guard in a throwaway project fails on a cancelled subtest; a guard that stops reporting cancellations is killed.
changes.remains_unproven: Nothing for P1.
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2C)

changes.why_sufficient: Unexpected skip and todo fail the run; the DB skip passes only with exact file+name and only while M1_DB_TEST_PG_URL is unset; accepting every skip, ignoring todo, ignoring the DB variable or matching by name only are each killed.
changes.remains_unproven: Finding F-2C-1: a test FILE without any test still passes the guard (not one of P1-P3; reported, not fixed).
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2C)

changes.why_sufficient: The real mutation runner reports KILLED only for the named expected failure (and message); other failures are KILLED_OTHER, behaviour-preserving edits SURVIVED, ambiguous anchors INVALID; counting any failure as the kill is caught.
changes.remains_unproven: Choice of expected failures per case remains a human review step (documented per case).
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2C)

changes.why_sufficient: One SURVIVED, KILLED_OTHER, INVALID or NOT_RUN case removes the known-bad proof of its property (status drops to MISSING_EVIDENCE); EQUIVALENT-only and static-only kills never prove; an engine ignoring SURVIVED is caught.
changes.remains_unproven: Nothing for P1.
changes.reason: new reproducible evidence (Phase 2C)

Test infrastructure (Low): node:test reports a test file without tests as one passing entry, so scripts/run-tests-guarded.mjs passes a security test file that lost all its tests. Reproduced in a throwaway project. Not fixed in this evidence pass; fix direction: count only non-file test events or require >= 1 test per file.
Engine credited a property while one of its mutation cases was NOT_RUN if another case was KILLED; now NOT_RUN blocks (never credit missing capabilities). Found by test/crsf-engine.test.mjs.

Engine trusted self-declared evidence levels, so behavioural evidence labelled E5 could satisfy a real-concurrency control; new per-type level cap (LEVEL_EXCEEDS_TYPE). EV-H2-REQ and EV-RL lowered from E2 to E1 (static); no status changed.
EQUIVALENT and MULTI_LAYER mutation semantics, NOT_RUN blocks known-bad proof, evidence_level_cap_by_type. No release class or minimum level changed.

P1 is worded "every no-param endpoint rejects any query"; alerts, config, csp-report, telegram and link/verify ignore (never read) the query instead of rejecting it. Security-wise the query cannot alter scope, but the literal property is not met. Not recorded as VIOLATION (would turn an over-specified internal wording into a release-blocking FAIL) and not silently reinterpreted: left MISSING_EVIDENCE for an owner decision (reword P1 to "no endpoint derives behaviour from undeclared query parameters", or add query rejection).

P2 (constant-time comparison) and P3 (algorithm/key not selectable) are construction properties; E4 (known-bad mutation) cannot observe constant time in a JS runtime, and the algorithm is structurally fixed. Threshold not lowered; needs an explicit framework decision (e.g. E1 static evidence for these sub-properties).
Dropped in Phase 2B; now kept visible as EQUIVALENT (UNREACHABLE) with written proof.
m1/h2/l1/l5 DB tests now drop their disposable database after the run (test-support/drop-test-db.mjs); new DB tests do the same. Phase 2B accumulated 454 databases and exhausted the scratch disk.
allowed skips added for DBPRIV-DB and DASHBOARD-LOGIN-DB, only while M1_DB_TEST_PG_URL is unset.
